name: Listings API
description:
ListingsAPI is a local citation and listings submission API: one REST call submits a business to 50+ listings sites — Google Business Profile, Apple Maps, Bing Places, Facebook, Yelp, and the rest of the major directories, maps, and answer engines — and keeps its name, address, phone, and hours in sync everywhere it appears.

This connector gives Claude direct access to that platform. Search the developer docs, browse every REST endpoint from the live OpenAPI spec, and call the API itself: create and update business locations, submit local citations across the directory network, track listing sync status, read and respond to reviews, publish posts to every connected profile, and pull local SEO analytics. Account tools cover API keys, usage, recent errors, and subscription state, so you can debug an integration without leaving the conversation.

Built for SaaS platforms, agencies, and developers shipping local SEO, citation submission, or listings management into their own product: ask "how do I create a location?" and Claude answers from the real spec, then makes the call with your key.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Listings API to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Listings API to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://listingsapi.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Listings API MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Listings API lists 57 MCP tools, including analytics_bing, analytics_facebook, analytics_google, connected_accounts_confirm_matches, connected_accounts_connect_listing, connected_accounts_create_google_listing, connected_accounts_create_location_from_listing, connected_accounts_facebook_connect_link, connected_accounts_get, connected_accounts_google_connect_link, connected_accounts_google_folders, and connected_accounts_list.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Listings API?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Listings API in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.

_published_faq.name: Does Listings API MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Listings API requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Listings API is developed by Listings API. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
